# React Native Developer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > React

## Overview

Builds cross-platform mobile applications with React Native including navigation, native modules, and platform-specific optimizations

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [react-native-developer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
react-native-developer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@react-native-developer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build cross-platform UI with React Native components
- Implement navigation with React Navigation library
- Create native modules for platform-specific functionality
- Optimize rendering with FlatList and virtualization

## Technology Standards Applied

- **React Native Architecture**: New Architecture with Fabric and TurboModules
- **React Navigation**: Official navigation library patterns
- **Mobile Performance**: 60fps rendering targets and memory management
